name: The Ember Table
tagline: A supper club of one long table, held by candlelight.
venuePolicy: The exact address is emailed to confirmed guests two days before the dinner. Until then, all we will say is: a private dining room in the West Village, a short walk from the 1 train.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the dinner?
faqs.answer: A private dining room in the West Village, a short walk from the 1 train. The exact address goes out by email to confirmed guests two days before the dinner.

faqs.question: I have an allergy — can the kitchen cook for me?
faqs.answer: Almost always. Note it in your RSVP and the menu is adjusted quietly at your place — no fuss at the table. For severe or airborne allergies, email first so we can talk it through honestly.

faqs.question: Can I come alone?
faqs.answer: Please do. Half the table usually arrives solo — you will be seated mid-table, where the conversation is, never on the awkward end.

faqs.question: How do I pay? Do I need an account?
faqs.answer: No accounts and no ticketing fees. You RSVP by email, the host confirms your seats and sends simple payment instructions in her reply. Seats are released if unpaid after 48 hours.

faqs.question: What if I need to cancel?
faqs.answer: Tell us as soon as you can. Your seat goes to the waitlist, and if it is re-filled — it usually is — you are refunded in full. You may also pass your seat to a friend by email.
